---
title: "Factors: Income Tier, Education Attainment and Elderly Rate"
format: html
---

```{=html}
<script src="https://cdn.plot.ly/plotly-latest.min.js"></script>
<script src="https://d3js.org/d3.v7.min.js"></script>
```

Boxplots reveal both distribution and variability at a glance. In this **Grouped Boxplot** view, we compare rental and ownership rates across quartiles of a selected factor:

- Choose **Income Tier** to see how low-, mid-, and high-income markets differ in tenure share.  
- Select **Education Attainment** to investigate whether more highly educated metros rent or own in greater numbers.  
- Toggle to **Elderly Rate** to understand how an aging population shapes the housing mix.

Each box shows the median, interquartile range, and outliers—helping you answer questions like “Which income group has the widest spread of rental rates?” or “Do high-education cities show consistently higher ownership?”

<style>
  #box-controls {
    margin-bottom: 16px;
    font-family: Arial, sans-serif;
  }
  #box-controls label {
    font-weight: bold;
    margin-right: 8px;
  }
  #box-controls select {
    padding: 4px 8px;
    font-size: 14px;
  }
  #box-plot {
    margin: auto;
  }
</style>

<div id="box-controls">
  <label for="group-by">Group by:</label>
  <select id="group-by">
    <option value="Income_Tier">Income Tier</option>
    <option value="Education_Attainment">Education Attainment</option>
    <option value="ElderlyRate">Elderly Rate</option>
  </select>
</div>

<div id="box-plot" style="width:900px; height:600px;"></div>

<script src="https://d3js.org/d3.v5.min.js"></script>
<script src="https://cdn.plot.ly/plotly-latest.min.js"></script>
<script>
  d3.csv("../data/All_merged.csv").then(function(data) {
    data.forEach(d => {
      d.HomeownershipRate          = +d.HomeownershipRate;
      d.RentalRate                 = +d.RentalRate;
      d.Bachelors_or_Higher_Rate   = +d.Bachelors_or_Higher_Rate;
      d.Less_than_High_School_Rate = +d.Less_than_High_School_Rate;
      d.ElderlyRate                = +d.ElderlyRate;
    });
    const colors = {
      HomeownershipRate: "#17084A",
      RentalRate:        "#DCBB5E"
    };
    let firstDraw = true;
    function drawBox(groupKey) {
      let groups, xTitle;
      if (groupKey === "Income_Tier") {
        groups = data.map(d => d.Income_Tier);
        xTitle = "Income Tier";
      } else if (groupKey === "Education_Attainment") {
        const arr = data.map(d => d.Bachelors_or_Higher_Rate).sort(d3.ascending);
        const med = d3.quantile(arr, 0.5);
        groups = data.map(d =>
          d.Bachelors_or_Higher_Rate >= med ? "High Education" : "Low Education"
        );
        xTitle = "Education Attainment";
      } else {
        const arr = data.map(d => d.ElderlyRate).sort(d3.ascending);
        const q1  = d3.quantile(arr, 1/3);
        const q2  = d3.quantile(arr, 2/3);
        groups = data.map(d =>
          d.ElderlyRate < q1 ? "Low Elderly Rate"
            : d.ElderlyRate < q2 ? "Mid Elderly Rate"
            : "High Elderly Rate"
        );
        xTitle = "Elderly Rate Segment";
      }
      const traces = ["HomeownershipRate","RentalRate"].map(varName => ({
        type: "box",
        x: groups,
        y: data.map(d => d[varName]),
        name: varName.replace(/([A-Z])/g,' $1').trim(),
        marker: { color: colors[varName], opacity: 0.4 },
        line:   { color: colors[varName] },
        boxpoints: "outliers",
        hovertemplate:
          "%{x}<br>" +
          varName.replace(/([A-Z])/g,' $1').trim() +
          ": %{y:.3f}<extra></extra>"
      }));
      const layout = {
        title: {
          text: `Homeownership & Rental Rates vs ${xTitle}`,
          font: { size: 18 },
          x: 0.5
        },
        xaxis: {
          title: xTitle,
          automargin: true
        },
        yaxis: {
          title: "Rate",
          automargin: true
        },
        margin: { l: 80, r: 50, t: 80, b: 80 },
        boxmode: "group",
        transition: { duration: 500, easing: "cubic-in-out" },
        font: { size: 12 }
      };
      if (firstDraw) {
        Plotly.newPlot("box-plot", traces, layout, { responsive: true });
        firstDraw = false;
      } else {
        Plotly.animate(
          "box-plot",
          { data: traces },
          { transition: layout.transition, frame: { duration: 500 } }
        );
      }
    }
    const sel = document.getElementById("group-by");
    sel.addEventListener("change", () => drawBox(sel.value));
    drawBox(sel.value);
  });
</script>
